_internal.label: Top Brand by Revenue
_internal.explanation: Brand contributing the highest revenue among classified products.
_internal.sql_used: SELECT br.name AS label,        COALESCE(SUM(s."Total Amount"), 0) AS value FROM sales s JOIN product_master pm ON pm.product_name = s."Product Name" JOIN product_hierarchy br ON br.id = pm.brand_id GROUP BY br.name ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 1
